findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal in file lock operations
 * @description File lock operations with unsanitized user input could allow path traversal
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/filelock-path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module PathTraversalConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource or
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "stat", "chmod"]).getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    ) or
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    ) or
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::builtin("open").getACall() and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module PathTraversalFlow = TaintTracking::Global<PathTraversalConfig>;
import PathTraversalFlow::PathGraph

from PathTraversalFlow::PathNode source, PathTraversalFlow::PathNode sink
where PathTraversalFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential path traversal from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities in file lock operations where user-controlled paths are used without sanitization

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Symlink following in file operations
 * @description File operations that follow symlinks without validation could be exploited
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock-symlink-following
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-059
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // os.stat without O_NOFOLLOW
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("stat").getACall() or
    // Path operations that follow symlinks
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["exists", "is_file", "stat"]).getACall() or
    // open without O_NOFOLLOW
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may follow symlinks without validation."
findings.hypothesis: Symlink attacks - Following symlinks in file locking operations could allow attackers to lock unintended files or escalate privileges

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition
 * @description Checking file existence or properties before using the file can lead to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock-toctou
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-367
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode check_call, DataFlow::CallCfgNode use_call
where
  (
    check_call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall() or
    check_call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getReturn().getMember(["exists", "is_file", "is_dir"]).getACall() or
    check_call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["stat", "lstat", "access"]).getACall()
  ) and
  (
    use_call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "rename"]).getACall() or
    use_call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  )
select check_call, "File existence check that may lead to TOCTOU race condition if followed by file operations."
findings.hypothesis: Race condition (TOCTOU) between file existence check and file operations in file locking

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unclosed file descriptor
 * @description File descriptors opened with os.open that may not be closed on all paths
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock-unclosed-fd
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-772
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() and
  not exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode close_call |
    close_call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("close").getACall()
  )
select call, "File descriptor opened with os.open may not be properly closed on all paths."
findings.hypothesis: Unclosed file descriptors or file handles that could lead to resource exhaustion

  ) and
  mode_arg = call.getArg(1)
select call, "File operation with potentially insecure permissions."

/**
 * @name Infinite loop or unbounded iteration
 * @description Loops without proper termination conditions can lead to denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/filelock-infinite-loop
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-835
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from While whileStmt
where
  not exists(Break b | b.getScope() = whileStmt.getScope()) and
  not exists(Return r | r.getScope() = whileStmt.getScope())
select whileStmt, "While loop may not have proper termination condition."
findings.hypothesis: Infinite loops without proper termination conditions that could lead to denial of service
